pages.text: What the Void Ruin Focus drags out is not wild. These are creepers that were swallowed and spat back - already sworn to a master the moment they land. They follow where you walk and squat where you tell them to keep watch.

They do not argue much. They simply stare at someone. Whatever is stared at rarely has time to run - the creeper appears at its feet, then gives itself, and a little of the void, away. Whatever it fails to finish goes home marked.
Some come back with teal runes. Those have been enchanted. Wild witches say they are less patient and hold their grudges longer: whatever they blast seldom lives to see the next one.
The $(thing)enchanted one$() comes from the same void, only it returned marked with teal runes. Quieter, and much less patient - it stares too, but for far less time.

Its blast is closer to a lightning strike: brighter to look at, and far worse to be near. Whatever survives one carries a heavier mark home - and wild witches say that mark bites once more when it runs out.
